question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A seat for a passenger on a bicycle or motorbike
solution:
The correct answer is **"Pillion"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Pillion- **a seat for a passenger behind a motorcyclist.
 
• **Girdle- **a belt or cord worn around the waist.
 
• **Bridle- **the headgear used to control a horse, consisting of buckled straps to which a bit and reins are attached.
 
• **Cushion- **a bag of cloth stuffed with a mass of soft material, used as a comfortable support for sitting or leaning on.
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. Pillion.**
